ElementDescription: The NDAR Global Unique Identifier (GUID) for research subject
Subject ID how it's defined in lab/project
Date on which the interview/genetic test/sampling/imaging/biospecimen was completed. MM/DD/YYYY
Age in months at the time of the interview/test/sampling/imaging.
Notes: Age is rounded to chronological month. If the research participant is 15-days-old at time of interview, the appropriate value would be 0 months. If the participant is 16-days-old, the value would be 1 month.
M = Male; F = Female; O=Other; NR = Not reported

ElementDescription: Can the participant use the phone?
Notes: 1 = Completely unable to use the phone; 2 = With some help; 3 = Without help (operates phone on own initiative, looks up, dials numbers, etc.)

ElementDescription: Can the participant get to places out of walking distance?
Notes: 1 = Completely unable to travel unless special arrangements are made (taxi or car with human assistance); 2 = With some help; 3 = Without help (travels independently: drives car, public transportation or use of taxi)

ElementDescription: Can the participant go shopping for groceries?
Notes: 1 = Completely unable to do any shopping; 2 = With some help (needs to be accompanied on any shopping trip); 3 = Without help; 88 = Resides in assisted living facility, does not do

ElementDescription: Can the participant prepare their own meals?
Notes: 1 = Completely unable to prepare meals (needs meals prepared and served); 2 = With some help (heat and serve prepared meals); 3 = Without help (plan, prepares, serves meals); 88 = Resides in assisted living facility, does not do
1 = Completely unable to do any housework; 2 = With some help; 3 = Without help (performs light daily tasks - dishwashing, bed making, etc.); 88 = Resides in assisted living facility, does not do

ElementDescription: Can the participant do their own handyman work?
Notes: 1 = Completely unable to do any handyman work; 2 = With some help; 3 = Without help; 88 = Resides in assisted living facility, does not do

ElementDescription: Can the participant do their own laundry?
Notes: 1 = Completely unable to use the laundry; 2 = With some help (such as using laundry service); 3 = Without help (does personal laundry Completely); 88 = Resides in assisted living facility, does not do

ElementDescription: Does the participant take medicines or use any medications?
Does the participant take their own medicines? (if ''yes'' to liadl_takemeds_a)
Notes: 1 = Completely unable to take own medicine; 2 = With some help (if someone prepares it or reminds them); 3 = Without help (in the right doses at the right time)

ElementDescription: If the participant had to take medicine, could they do it? (if ''no'' to liadl_takemeds_a)
Notes: 1 = Completely unable to take medicine; 2 = With some help (if someone prepares it or reminds you); 3 = Without help (in the right doses at the right time)

ElementDescription: Can the participant manage their own money?
Notes: 1 = Completely unable to manage own money; 2 = With some help (manages day to day purchases, needs help With banking, major purchases); 3 = Without help

ElementDescription: Was the questionnaire completed by the participant themselves or by a proxy informant?
